summary: Phase 1 (Production Library Explorer + Estimating Sidebar) end-to-end frontend testing PASSED on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). All 11 review-request items verified: sidebar Estimating parent expands and highlights, 4 sub-items (Estimate Workbench / Production Library / Assemblies / Templates) render with correct data-testids and route correctly; /app/estimating/library loads the Windows-Explorer-style tree with 24 domain folders; expanding Commercial reveals 137 tree nodes with production codes (C001..C0xx) as monospace green badges; search filters the tree (drywall -> 1 match, C001 -> exact match); right-click on any tree node opens a context menu (View Details / Edit / Add to Estimate / Duplicate / Archive / Delete); /app/estimating shows the Phase 2 Coming Soon banner; /app/estimating/assemblies and /app/estimating/templates show their Coming Soon states; mobile view auto-expands Estimating in the hamburger drawer, exposes a full-width primary 'Browse Library' CTA (data-testid=browse-library-btn) that opens the full-screen iOS Files-style modal with search input, tree, and 'New Standard' footer; no horizontal scroll on the library page at 390 (docSW=clientW=390).

critical_code_review_comments: ProductionLibraryExplorer.jsx is 782 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Data-fetching (fetchData), context-menu action handlers (handleContextAction ~140 lines with 9 cases), and modal wiring should each be extracted into hooks/subcomponents (e.g., useLibraryData, useLibraryContextActions) before it grows further.

TreeView.jsx auto-expand effect (lines 141-163) calls onToggleExpand?.({ id }) inside a useEffect whose deps include filteredTree — this can cause repeated state churn when the parent re-renders. Consider batching expansions with a single setExpandedNodes(prev => new Set([...prev, ...ids])) callback on the parent, or memoise the id list and gate the effect on searchQuery only.

TreeNode.jsx onSelect is fired on click for containers ONLY via onToggle (line 65-70) — the current UX makes clicking a domain/category row expand only; users cannot 'select' a container to see it in the right pane's detail card without right-clicking → View Details. Consider a dedicated select area (icon or label) versus the chevron for expand.

ProductionLibraryExplorer.jsx line 176: `rect = e.target.getBoundingClientRect()` — e.target may be a nested icon/span when right-clicking; using currentTarget is safer for consistent context-menu positioning.

index.js barrel export in components/ProductionLibrary imports DomainDialog/CategoryDialog from ./Management and ContextMenu from ./Shared — these subfolders were not viewed in this test; verify they exist and export defaults to avoid runtime module-not-found (the app did load, so exports resolve, but flagging for lint hygiene).

Search auto-expansion iterates the entire filtered tree on every keystroke (TreeView.jsx 141-163). For 367 standards this is fine; consider a debounce (150-250ms) on searchQuery in the parent before it hits this effect to reduce unnecessary Set diffs while typing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 is functionally complete and visually correct on desktop and mobile. Pre-existing 'Failed to fetch' console errors on /api/workspace/context + /api/command-center + useOrganization persist since iteration_26 — do NOT re-flag as a Phase 1 regression. Screenshots saved to /app/.screenshots/library_desktop.png, /library_mobile.png, /library_mobile_drawer.png, /mobile_browser_open.png, /context_menu.png. Note that ContextMenu is rendered without role='menu' so any future test using [role='menu'] to detect it will return 0 — use text=View Details or a class-based selector instead.
